3 Show only on the home screen

Floating Pet uses Android “Usage access” to detect the home screen. This permission allows access to usage events from other apps. Detection happens only on this device. No usage history is saved or sent.

While the screen is on, “Response priority” checks about every 0.2 seconds; power-saving mode checks about every 0.5 seconds. The pet may linger briefly after switching apps. Detection may be inaccurate on some devices, in Recents, or in split screen. The pet is hidden when the home screen cannot be identified.
Set up usage access
Open “Usage access” for Floating Pet in Android settings.
Response priority (off for power saving)

Response priority makes up to 2.5 times as many queries as power-saving mode and may use more battery. Checks stop when the screen is off and slow down automatically if queries are slow or fail. Android event-delivery delays can still occur.
4 Make it your own
Calm by default
While waiting, the pet moves gently as if breathing. It reacts briefly to touch and follows your movement direction only while being dragged. A tap opens ChatGPT immediately.
Move gently while waiting
Turn this off to keep the pet still while waiting. It also stays still when Android animations are disabled. Breathing uses a small image transform; no new poses are added to the artwork.
